title: The same coursework project, assigned for the interview it will face
takeaway: Scope, checkpoints and a rubric weighted to decisions and the viva turn a mini project into something a student can defend.
sources: The difference between a project that helps in placements and one that does not is almost entirely in how it is assigned and assessed.
A project brief of "build an e-commerce platform" produces a folder of half-finished pages and a student who cannot explain any of them.
The decision log is the most valuable artefact in the list.
Most of the marks sit in the decision log and the viva, which are the parts that cannot be copied.

before.label: Assigned for output
lines: Marks for features and interface polish

after.label: Assigned for the interview
lines: One core feature with a real constraint
Proposal, core, hardening, decision log, viva
Result: a working link and a decision log
